description: This file defines the Ext.ux.ToolbarDroppable class, a plugin for Ext JS 3.2.1 that enables drag-and-drop functionality to add items to a toolbar dynamically. It includes methods for initializing the plugin, creating drop targets, calculating insertion points, and handling drop events.

classes.name: Ext.ux.ToolbarDroppable
classes.description: A plugin class that allows items to be dropped onto an Ext JS toolbar, converting drop data into new toolbar items.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with configuration options.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up the plugin with a toolbar, creating a drop target and binding event handlers.

methods.name: createDropTarget
methods.description: Creates a new Ext.dd.DropTarget on the toolbar element to handle drag-and-drop.

methods.name: addDDGroup
methods.description: Adds a drag-and-drop group to the drop target.

methods.name: calculateEntryIndex
methods.description: Calculates the position on the toolbar to insert a new item based on the drag event's XY coordinates.

methods.name: canDrop
methods.description: Determines if a drop is allowed; defaults to always true but can be overridden.

methods.name: notifyOver
methods.description: Provides visual feedback during drag-over, indicating whether dropping is allowed.

methods.name: notifyDrop
methods.description: Handles the drop event, creating and inserting a new toolbar item if allowed.

methods.name: createItem
methods.description: Abstract method to create a new toolbar item from drop data; must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: afterLayout
methods.description: Hook called after a new item has been added to the toolbar for any additional processing.
